# GEN rules

## GEN-001 Conventional Commits are enforced in CI

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

A machine-readable history drives changelogs and release notes and makes review faster.

**Verified by:** `file-contains`

**How to fix:** Add a PR-title or commit-message check to the CI workflow.

## GEN-002 CI runs on every pull request

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Nothing reaches main without the same gates that run locally.

**Verified by:** `file-contains`

**How to fix:** Trigger .github/workflows/ci.yml on pull_request.

## GEN-003 Dependency updates are automated

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Outdated dependencies are the most common route to known vulnerabilities.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

**How to fix:** Add .github/dependabot.yml with grouped weekly updates.

## GEN-004 SECURITY.md describes a real reporting path

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Reporters need a private channel; template text is a sign nobody looked.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`, `file-not-contains`

**How to fix:** Name the contact, the supported versions and the response time.

## GEN-005 LICENSE is present

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Public code without a licence is not reusable; private code documents its terms.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

## GEN-006 CHANGELOG keeps an Unreleased section

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

User-visible changes are written when they happen, not reconstructed at release time.

**Verified by:** `file-contains`

**How to fix:** Keep a changelog; put new entries under [Unreleased].

## GEN-007 .editorconfig fixes whitespace and line endings

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Editors agree on indentation and newlines, so diffs show only real changes.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

## GEN-008 CODEOWNERS names reviewers

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Every change has an accountable reviewer, also when an agent wrote it.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

## GEN-009 Pull request template asks for the checklist

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

The checklist makes the definition of done visible at the moment it matters.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

## GEN-010 Architecture decisions are recorded

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Decisions without a recorded reason are re-litigated or silently reversed.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

**How to fix:** Create docs/adr/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md.

## GEN-011 Environment files are git-ignored

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Secrets in history cannot be un-leaked.

**Verified by:** `file-contains`

**How to fix:** Add .env* and !.env.example to .gitignore.

## GEN-012 Third-party dependencies are justified

**Level:** proposed · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Every dependency is attack surface and upgrade work; a register states why it is worth it and what the native alternative was.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

**How to fix:** Add docs/dependencies.md: name, purpose, native alternative considered, owner.

## GEN-013 README gives a way in

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

A project nobody can start is not a project.

**Verified by:** `file-exists`

## GEN-014 A lockfile is committed

**Level:** must · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

Reproducible installs are the base of supply-chain control.

**Verified by:** `file-named`

**How to fix:** Commit the lock file; per-project lock files (NuGet packages.lock.json) count anywhere in the repository.

## GEN-020 Vendor and platform modules are preferred over third-party ones

**Level:** should · **Applies to:** all projects · **Since:** 0.1.0

First-party and standard-library modules are maintained with the platform, audited more often and carry no extra supply chain.

**Verified by:** `manual`

**How to fix:** Before adding a dependency, check the platform first and note the result in the PR.
